cases.title: Review a system architecture
cases.request: Review the architecture of a service before implementation and identify design risks.
cases.notes: The canonical specialist owns architecture review.

cases.title: Define service boundaries
cases.request: Assess the proposed service boundaries and recommend an architecture that keeps responsibilities clear.
cases.notes: This is an architecture-ownership request without a competing approved owner.

cases.title: Threat-model a new feature
cases.request: Create a threat model for the new authentication feature and identify security controls that are missing.
cases.notes: Security review is an approved capability of the canonical specialist.

cases.title: Review API security design
cases.request: Review the API authentication and authorization design for security weaknesses before it ships.
cases.notes: The request is directly within the approved security-review capability.

cases.title: Assess data flows
cases.request: Assess the system data flows and architecture for unsafe trust boundaries and recommend changes.
cases.notes: Logical routing ownership remains architecture and security even when the configured runtime is unverified.

cases.title: Identify architecture risks
cases.request: Identify the highest-risk architectural decisions in this proposal and explain how to reduce them.
cases.notes: Architecture risk assessment is covered by the approved architecture capability.

cases.title: Plan a personal budget
cases.request: Create a personal monthly budget and recommend how to allocate savings across expenses.
cases.notes: The request is unrelated to the approved architecture and security ownership.

cases.title: Plan a trip
cases.request: Plan a seven-day vacation itinerary with restaurants and sightseeing recommendations.
cases.notes: No approved specialist owns travel planning.

cases.title: Write marketing copy
cases.request: Write a launch announcement and social media copy for a new consumer product.
cases.notes: The wording describes a product but does not request architecture or security work.

cases.title: Draft an HR policy
cases.request: Draft a workplace leave policy and employee communication for a small business.
cases.notes: No approved specialist owns human-resources policy drafting.

cases.title: Create a recipe
cases.request: Create a vegetarian dinner recipe using lentils, tomatoes, and spinach.
cases.notes: The request has no approved architecture or security owner.

cases.title: Translate a document
cases.request: Translate this customer letter from Spanish into English while preserving its tone.
cases.notes: A customer-facing document is not evidence of architecture or security ownership.
